transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. As you know, the board has authorized us to consider repurchasing up to 5,000,000 common shares this quarter. With our stock trading near $8.25 and sufficient cash on hand, I'd like to move through our standard capital-return review process. Before I finalize any authorization, I need input from each of your areas: treasury on cash positioning and funding, legal and compliance on any regulatory considerations, and investor relations on how the market might interpret different offer structures. The board has left the offer size, price, and execution method open, so I want to make sure we're thorough. What are you each seeing from your end?
